method.method_draft: Trace only the main top-left-to-bottom-right path. From the image, identify the upper-left square as R and the question mark as lying on the same main diagonal direction down-right from it. The visible labels show that moving one step right or one step down advances one place in the sequence R, W, B, G, P, so moving one step down-right advances two places in the colour cycle. From the text, the square is 10 by 10, so from the upper-left cell to the lower-right cell there are 9 down-right moves. Starting at red and advancing two colour positions 9 times gives an advance of 18 positions. Since the colour cycle length is 5, 18 leaves remainder 3 after full cycles; red advanced 3 positions is green: red -> white -> blue -> green. Thus the lower-right square is green.
